visual.detailed_description: Circular field of view with a black surround. Pink to red tissue fills the field, with fine hairs along the lower-left and right edges. A translucent, tubular strand begins at a visible pale end left of centre, runs right across the centre and curves down and back in a loop toward the lower right. A black triangle marker at the centre, below the strand and inside the loop, points upward toward the strand, and a black arrow in the upper right points toward the upper edge. No printed panel letters, scale or text are visible.

visual.general_description: Four endoscopic-style circular views labeled a to d, each with a black or white marker.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 grid of circular views on a black background with panel letters a to d at the lower left of each. Panel a: Circular field with a black surround and a letter a printed at the lower left. Tissue with fine hairs fills the right half and a dark opening is visible at the upper centre. A translucent tubular strand loops at the left, partly over pink-red tissue. A black arrow in the lower left points toward the lower left. Panel b: Circular field with a black surround and a letter b printed at the lower left. Pale pink tissue with fine vessels fills the field and a bright red patch occupies the lower left. Whitish strands cross the upper centre. A dark rounded opening at the right contains a grayish elongated structure, and a white arrow from the left points at it. Panel c: Circular field with a black surround and a letter c printed at the lower left. Red-pink tissue with a pale ridge across the upper centre fills the field. A translucent tubular strand forms a loop in the lower left; a black triangle sits between its two limbs with its apex pointing left at the left limb. A black arrow at the upper centre points down and to the left at the tissue edge just above the right limb of the strand. Panel d: Circular field with a black surround and a letter d printed at the lower left. An irregular red and pink textured surface fills the centre and lower half, with paler tissue at the upper left and right. A fine thin line crosses the left part of the field. A black arrow in the lower centre points toward the lower left.
